name: 3W Clinic Honey Eye Cream 40ml | Korea
description:
3W Clinic Honey This eye cream revitalise and firm up the thin skin around the eyes. Including Honey and propolis complex. Honey and propolis extract helps to smoothing wrinkle your eye rims. It gives nourishing and whitening effect to your skin. 

Nourishing Honey Eye Cream actively moisturizes the delicate skin of the eyelids, eliminates puffiness, brightens dark circles under the eyes, reduces the number and depth of wrinkles, improves elasticity and firmness. 
Extracts of honey, propolis and beeswax have a beneficial effect on the condition of mature and dry skin, smooth its microrelief, soften and nourish, stimulate regeneration, promote healing of injuries, remove toxins and stimulate immunity. 
Sunflower oil has a softening, antioxidant and anti-aging effect. 
Adenosine reduces the depth of wrinkles, improves skin relief, increases its elasticity and slows down the manifestation of age-related changes. 
Hyaluronic Acid maintains optimal hydrobalance, preventing dehydration and premature aging. 
This eye cream revitalize and firm up the thin skin around the eyes. 
Including Honey and propolis complex. 
Honey and propolis extract helps to smoothing wrinkle your eye rims. 
It gives nourishing and whitening effect to your skin. 
Made in Korea.
